contracts.description: Develops requirements/testing protocols, performs user acceptance testing for VHA Ops. Educate and trains staff on the workflows needed to exchange health info with external providers, enhances care, decreases wait time & facilitates timely transfers.

Assists Federated Interagency Terminology Service (FITS) a Joint VA DoD team that addresses clinical data and terminology needs in the Oracle Health environment, ensuring key clinical data is consistent & usable among users maximizing quality & efficiency

Enables increased efficiencies, eliminates waste, and reduces spending by ensuring that VA is included at standards development ensuring Veterans needs are met. Ensures in-depth knowledge of the standard to aid in efficient & correct implementation.
